summary: Completed frontend-only hero regression on public preview URL covering desktop and 390px mobile behaviors, motion interactions, CTA, and accessibility-related reduced-motion behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Framer Motion emits repeated runtime warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...' during hero render/scroll checks.

action_items: Resolve the Framer Motion container-position warning for the hero scroll target so console remains clean during production interaction.
Add explicit data-testid for helmet card/image (and other critical hero visual primitives) to improve deterministic regression coverage for required entrance elements.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroV2.css is minified into a single compressed line, reducing maintainability and making targeted debugging/reviews harder.
Hero pointer/parallax relies on heroRef geometry; keep explicit positioned ancestor contracts for all motion containers to avoid scroll-offset calculation drift and warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://lewis-victories.preview.emergentagent.com. Passed: desktop/mobile no horizontal overflow, entrance reveal elements (title/portrait/helmet/44/stats/intro), hero+helmet naturalWidth > 0, desktop pointer/parallax transforms, scroll fade (hero title opacity 1->0), stat count settle (105/7/104), CTA to legacy, decorative elements present, mobile hides CTA+telemetry+pointer while preserving key content, reduced-motion disables looping animations. Remaining issue: repeated Framer Motion warning in console about non-static container position.
rca of the issue: Repro: load page and interact/scroll around hero section; console repeatedly logs Framer Motion warning about container position for scroll offset calculations. Likely cause is useScroll target/container position contract mismatch (target interpreted relative to a static-position context in runtime). Mitigation: ensure explicit non-static positioning on the intended scroll container/target chain used by useScroll or adjust useScroll configuration to avoid ambiguous container context.
